1.consolidated_definition: dep. Aceleración que realiza un deportista en un tramo determinado de una carrera. Neologismo anglicado, poco frecuente. También esprint. La diferencia estriba en que Messi arrancó desde la media cancha, driblando horizontalmente, en la endiablada esprintada. Se llevó a 5 por delante, incluido el portero (El Nuevo Día, 26-04-07)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Acceleration achieved by an athlete in a specific segment of a race. Anglicized neologism, relatively uncommon. Also sprint. The difference lies in the fact that Messi started from midfield, dribbling horizontally, in the diabolical sprinting effort. He took 5 players ahead, including the goalkeeper (The New Day, 26-04-07).
